explanation: Aged six, she was given the first Academy Juvenile Award, a small statuette, for her films of 1934. As an adult, Shirley Temple Black became a US ambassador to Ghana.

claims.text: In February 1935 Shirley Temple received a miniature Academy Award, the Academy Juvenile Award.
Shirley Temple was six years old when she received the award, which honoured her work in 1934.
Shirley Temple was the first person to receive the Academy Juvenile Award.
As an adult, Shirley Temple Black served as the United States ambassador to Ghana.
